blogPost: Building an Agentic RAG System — LangGraph, Hybrid Retrieval & SQL Reasoning
explanation: Currently building an end-to-end Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using LangGraph to orchestrate intelligent, self-healing workflows. The project combines semantic document retrieval with LLM-driven SQL analytics, enabling the system to dynamically decide between retrieval, computation, or hybrid reasoning based on user intent. The architecture integrates DuckDB as a lightweight analytical engine for structured queries, alongside a vector-based retriever for unstructured data. Conditional routing, retry loops, and reflection nodes allow the system to recover from execution failures and improve response reliability — moving beyond static RAG pipelines toward agentic decision-making. An automated evaluation pipeline using RAGAS measures faithfulness, relevance, and answer quality across predefined evaluation prompts, providing quantitative feedback on system performance. This project deepens expertise in agentic AI systems, hybrid retrieval + analytics architectures, and production-style evaluation workflows, bridging data engineering, analytics, and modern AI-driven decision intelligence.

blogPost: Data Insights Portfolio — EV Market & Job Market Dashboards
explanation: Combined analytics from two major projects: Electric Vehicle Market Analysis and The Data Job Market Dashboard. These works showcase the ability to transform complex datasets into actionable insights across sustainability and career intelligence domains. In the EV Market Analysis, explored the global rise of Electric Vehicles (EVs) vs Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs) using Python (Pandas) and Tableau. Uncovered trends in EV vs PHEV market share, MSRP segmentation, and Tesla’s performance across adoption regions. Meanwhile, the Data Job Market Dashboard analyzed thousands of Canadian data roles to correlate skills, experience, and pay range. Built using Python, SQL, dbt, and Tableau, this dashboard revealed demand clusters and high-value skill intersections. Learnings: Strengthened expertise in end-to-end analytics pipelines, refined data storytelling across technical and environmental contexts, and gained deep insight into how data visualization drives both sustainability and workforce decisions.
